digest.component_or_area: test suite infrastructure — regression test subsumption analysis
propositions: The generic reads-under-sync-contention property does not subsume the original test because seeds F3 and F6 (shape-valid but content-incomplete payloads: empty JSON and missing ticket_id) are caught only by the original regression test.
Fault-seeded evidence shows the two test oracles are complements rather than duplicates: F5 and F7 failures are caught only by the generic property, proving neither test subsumes the other.

Reverting the actual slim-fetch-ledge fix leaves both burst tests green; only the deterministic held-lock tests detect the regression, indicating the 48-subprocess storm is not a reliable oracle for the fixed race.
The partial-success assertion in the original test (doc.get('ticket_id')) is uniquely held and represents real detection power that would be forfeited by consolidation.
Process concurrency and cleanup remain observable and functional across all fault seeds, confirming the harness exercises real subprocess and threading behavior.
Consolidation is unsafe per mutation testing standards (Just et al. FSE 2014) because removing the original test decreases mutation score on seeds F3 and F6.
